data.title: Origin Investments/Mill Creek Residential Announce Modera Paradise Valley II in Phoenix
data.description:
Origin Investments/Mill Creek Residential Announce Modera Paradise Valley II in Phoenix

Origin Investments/Mill Creek Residential Announce Modera Paradise Valley II in Phoenix

PR Newswire

CHICAGO, Nov. 19, 2026

Origin Launches $52.7 Million Single Asset QOZ Investment Opportunity Intersecting QOZ 2.0 Benefits and the QOZ 1.0 Map

CHICAGO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Origin Investments, a leading private real estate firm, and Mill Creek Residential, a national investment and rental housing company, have announced plans for Modera Paradise Valley II, a 380-unit Class A multifamily community that is within the Paradise Valley Mall redevelopment area and includes 500,000 square feet of walkable retail space.

Origin will fund the project as a single-asset Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) investment and raise $52.7 million in equity. The offering will accept capital beginning January 1, 2027, when the "OZ 2.0" tax benefits created by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act take effect. The benefits of investing capital gains in a Qualified Opportunity Fund include a rolling five-year deferral of federal capital gains tax, a 10% basis step-up after five years, and tax-free appreciation after a 10-year hold. 

The Modera Paradise Valley II site sits in one of Phoenix's original Opportunity Zones, designated in 2018. Treasury guidance issued this year allows new investment into original-zone projects after 2026 as long as the project has a qualifying working capital plan in place and meets certain other qualified opportunity zone business requirements. Modera Paradise Valley II intends to fulfill those requirements.

"Modera Paradise Valley II is an OZ offering that features the investment benefits of 2.0 while developing a 1.0 location," said Michael Episcope, Co-CEO, Origin Investments. "We believe the stars are finally aligning in the multifamily sector to create meaningful upside for investors, and we believe this location is one of the best in the country."

Those factors, according to Episcope, include partnering with an experienced developer and general contractor like Mill Creek Residential, completing Modera Paradise Valley II at a strong, competitive cost basis with conservative rent positioning, and delivering the project at a time when we expect demand may outpace supply. 

The benefits of an investment in the project include:

  • Trophy Location—Positioned within the Paradise Valley Mall redevelopment, the property is to sit alongside premium retail anchors including Life Time Fitness and Whole Foods. Including those anchors, the site is walkable to approximately 500,000 square feet of retail and entertainment options.

  • Below Market Basis—Origin and MCR expect to deliver the new community at approximately $400K per unit, well below recent comparable trades in the immediate area. The parcel is already zoned for multifamily by-right, so no rezoning or entitlement process remains. Rents are underwritten conservatively, leaving room for upside if performance tracks comparable properties in the area.

  • Experienced Partnership—Mill Creek Residential will serve as both developer and general contractor. With over 30 years of experience and more than 275,000 rental homes delivered, this will be their 10th Phoenix project and third with Origin, which Origin believes supports its confidence in on-budget delivery.

  • Opportunity Zone 2.0 Benefits—An investment funded after January 1, 2027, provides the following benefits: Federal tax on the original capital gain is deferred for five years; after a 5-year hold, the basis in the deferred gain steps up by 10%; and after a 10-year hold, investors can step up the basis in their investment to its fair market value, permanently excluding appreciation and depreciation recapture from federal taxes.

The minimum contribution for an investment in this opportunity zone investment is $50,000. Origin is targeting a net equity multiple ranging from 2.0 to 2.3x and a net IRR of 9-11% based on a holding period of 10 years. These targets are not guarantees, and actual performance may differ. 

Modera Paradise Valley II, located at 4510 E Cactus Road on a 4.94-acre parcel, is planned as a 380-unit, Class A wrap development that will mirror the quality standards established at Mill Creek's Modera branded communities across the country. The development will be comprised of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartment homes. 

In keeping with MCR's Modera brand, Modera Paradise Valley II will feature top-of-market, hospitality-inspired amenities, including a resort-style pool, outdoor kitchen, poolside cabanas, lounge seating, and outdoor grilling and entertainment areas with fire features. That caliber of amenities will extend to the resident clubhouse and include an entertainment lounge, modern dining and bar space, and a membership-quality fitness center. Additional offerings include high-end coworking spaces, and private conference rooms. 

Apartment home interiors will include a variety of deluxe features, including stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, tile backsplashes, luxury vinyl-plank flooring, premium cabinetry, kitchen islands, undermount sinks, under-cabinet lighting, full-size washers and dryers, private patios or balconies, roller shades and a variety of smart home features, including smart thermostats and keyless entry. Bathrooms are planned to feature double vanities, tile tub and shower surrounds and backlit LED mirrors. 

Construction of Modera Paradise Valley II could begin as early as Spring 2027. Completion would occur approximately 24 months later. 

The Modera Paradise Valley II site is within a coveted submarket in the Phoenix MSA. It is situated at the convergence of Cactus Rd. and Tatum Blvd. which provides quality access to Loop 101 and Route 51. This location connects residents to the greater Phoenix region. The Town of Paradise Valley, located 1.3 miles south, has an average household income of $408K and an average home value of $5M.

Paradise Valley is an affluent enclave between Phoenix and Scottsdale, known for luxury resorts, high-end retail, and some of the metro's strongest household-income demographics. More than 185,000 jobs are located within seven miles, with major employment concentrations in healthcare and financial services. Additionally, the affordability rating in a three-mile radius surrounding the site is 24. Modera Paradise Valley II is well positioned and aligned with the demographics for the area.

"Modera Paradise Valley II has the critical attributes that we believe are necessary to be a successful multifamily investment even before it derives any additional investor benefits from being in an opportunity zone," said Jacob Sojka, Vice President, Origin Investments. "We're very excited about adding this to our portfolio of properties in Arizona and across the West and Southwestern U.S."

The release of plans for Modera Paradise Valley II follows the recent announcement that Origin and Mill Creek Residential are partnering on Modera Old Town, a 190-unit OZ development in Old Town Scottsdale.

Since 2018, Origin has announced more than 20 opportunity zone investments with plans to develop more than 5,000 units. Similarly, MCR has made 12 opportunity zone investments to develop approximately 3,800 units. Origin is a top 2% national qualified opportunity zone (QOZ) fund manager1 based on capital raised according to Novogradac, a national certified public accounting (CPA) and consulting firm that specializes in real estate, community development, and tax incentives.

  1. Origin was ranked 11th out of 993 Qualified Opportunity Zone fund managers in terms of the amount of equity raised, according to the Novogradac Opportunity Zones Investment Report. As of 6/30/25. 

About Mill Creek Residential 

Mill Creek Residential is a national investment and rental housing company focused on developing, constructing, and operating multifamily and built-to-rent communities in targeted markets nationwide. Headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, the company operates across the United States through a seasoned team of professionals, with a presence in many of the nation's most desirable markets, including Seattle, Portland, the San Francisco Bay Area, Sacramento, Southern California, Salt Lake City, Phoenix, Denver, Dallas, Austin, Houston, South Florida, Tampa, Orlando, Atlanta, Nashville, Charlotte, Raleigh, Washington, D.C., New Jersey, New York, and Boston. As of June 30, 2026, the company's portfolio is comprised of 153 communities representing nearly 43,000 rental homes operating or under construction. Visit MillCreekPlaces.com for more information. 

About Origin Investments 

Founded in 2007, Origin Investments is a private real estate manager that helps high-net-worth investors, family offices and registered investment advisors grow and preserve wealth by providing tax-efficient real estate solutions through private funds. We build, buy and finance multifamily real estate projects in fast-growing markets throughout the U.S. In 2023, we founded affiliate firm Origin Credit Advisers, an SEC-registered investment adviser that provides yield-focused multifamily debt investments. Registration with the SEC does not imply a certain level of skill or training and does not constitute an endorsement, approval, or sponsorship by the SEC. Through our Origin Exchange platform, introduced in 2024, investors can complete a 1031 exchange of their properties for professionally managed, institutional-quality assets. To learn more, visit www.origininvestments.com.

data.title: Stock Futures Rise Ahead of Anthropic Trading Debut — Update
data.description:
By Joe Stonor

Nasdaq futures led a rally in U.S. stocks premarket, after Anthropic's pricing of its hotly anticipated listing lifted confidence around the artificial-intelligence trade.

The expectation-beating IPO pricing of the company behind the Claude chatbot helped investor focus shift away from the AI jitters that have weighed on stocks so far this week. However, sentiment was tempered by hawkish Federal Reserve meeting minutes Wednesday that added to fears of extended policy tightening.

Nasdaq futures jumped 2% as chip makers and cloud-computing stocks rallied premarket. Anthropic sold more shares at a higher price than anticipated, implying a value of around $1.5 trillion for the company. S&P 500 futures were also in the green--up 1.2%--as the index looks to turn the tide on a fifth-straight day of losses. Contracts tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.6%. The index has fallen by more than 1% for three days in a row.

Equities were mixed across Asia, where the tech-dominated Nikkei Stock Average in Japan and South Korea's Kospi closed in the green. Stock indexes in Hong Kong and Shanghai fell, however. In Europe, major indexes were mixed as the continent-wide Stoxx 600 slipped 0.1%.

Treasury yields ticked higher after falling in Asian trade, as investors respond to a hawkish readout from the Fed's October meeting. Near-term rate-sensitive two-year yields rose above 4.800%, while 10-year yields nudged back toward 5.100%. Thirty-year yields hovered around 5.440%.

Oil prices rose, picking up from falls Wednesday after U.S. crude oil inventories rose for a second consecutive week. The benchmark Brent crude contract rose 1% to trade around $93 a barrel, while the West Texas Intermediate contract nudged up 0.9% to trade around $84 a barrel.

The dollar fell slightly, but remained close to its highest level against a basket of global currencies since January 2025. Copper prices steadied after falling sharply in the last session but gold extended losses, trading close to $3,700 a troy ounce. Bitcoin rallied after recent declines, adding over 2% to trade around $63,750.

Anthropic's trading debut will be in focus for the day ahead. Investors will also watch for readouts from the trilateral meeting between President Trump, Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen.

data.title: Aslaug Magnusdottir, Moda Operandi Co-Founder, Launches Tinker Tailor: An AI Fashion Platform That Lets You Design What You Wear
data.description:
Aslaug Magnusdottir, Moda Operandi Co-Founder, Launches Tinker Tailor: An AI Fashion Platform That Lets You Design What You Wear

Aslaug Magnusdottir, Moda Operandi Co-Founder, Launches Tinker Tailor: An AI Fashion Platform That Lets You Design What You Wear

PR Newswire

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026

Shoppers can create their own made-to-order garments with AI guidance or discover collections designed by Featured Creators.

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Aslaug Magnusdottir today announced the launch of the new Tinker Tailor, an AI-supported fashion design and shopping platform that takes users from an idea to a finished garment, made to order and delivered to their doorstep.

Tinker Tailor offers two ways to discover something personal: shoppers can purchase designs from Featured Creators' collections or create their own dresses, tops and skirts. Featured Creators use the same design tools to develop collections, sell through dedicated storefronts and earn a commission on sales, while Tinker Tailor handles production and fulfillment.

"I've wanted to make this kind of creative freedom possible for over a decade," said Magnusdottir, Founder and CEO of Tinker Tailor, deemed "Fashion's Fairy Godmother" by Vogue. "Technology is finally bringing that vision within reach. Whether you want to create one piece for yourself or build a collection to share with others, Tinker Tailor helps turn your ideas into high quality fashion items made specifically for you."

At the heart of the platform is Tara, Tinker Tailor's AI design assistant. Users describe what they have in mind, and Tara helps them explore silhouettes, fabrics, colors and prints. They can refine their choices in the Design Studio and preview their garment in 3D before ordering.

The technology is grounded in traditional garment-making expertise. Designs draw on a library of patterns and compatible components developed by Tinker Tailor's atelier team in New York. Tinker Tailor combines these foundations with digital visualization and a network of manufacturers capable of producing garments individually, on demand.

The platform, designed by creative agency Trends&Culture, launches with dresses, tops and skirts, with additional categories planned over time. Its design library brings together a wide range of silhouettes, premium fabrics, colors and prints, giving users the freedom to explore their personal style without needing technical design training.

Tinker Tailor's marketplace also introduces collections from its first five curated Featured Creators: Mary Leest, Paula Dhier, Eugenia Kuzmina, Sanaz Dizaj Parham and Janet Gunn. Each has a dedicated storefront where followers and Tinker Tailor shoppers can discover and purchase their designs. New Featured Creators will launch on the site on a weekly basis.

By producing items only after an order is placed, Tinker Tailor removes the need to manufacture finished inventory in anticipation of demand. Featured Creators can introduce collections without purchasing stock or managing manufacturing and delivery themselves.

Tinker Tailor builds on Magnusdottir's longstanding work connecting consumers more directly with fashion. Magnusdottir, who co-founded Moda Operandi, pioneered online access to runway preorders. With Tinker Tailor, she is expanding who gets to participate in the design process. Her experience also includes senior leadership at Gilt Groupe, founding sustainable womenswear brand Katla, and co-founding fashion and retail investment company TSM Capital alongside Bloomingdale's legend Marvin Traub.

Tinker Tailor's investment round was led by Icelandic venture capital firm Brunnur Ventures. "Aslaug has built companies that have changed the way people shop for fashion," says Einar Þór Gústafsson, Investment Director at Brunnur Ventures. "She knows the industry inside out and has a clear sense of the opportunities technology can create. Tinker Tailor tackles one of the fashion industry's biggest challenges: taking a creative idea into production. We see real potential in what Aslaug and her team are building and look forward to supporting them as they grow the business."

Starting today, shoppers can register at tinkertailor.com, explore and shop Featured Creator collections and begin designing their own garments. Those interested in selling a collection can apply to become a Featured Creator.

Media Assets (Images & Logo) Here

Media contact:
press@tinkertailor.com

About Tinker Tailor

tinkertailor.com 

Tinker Tailor is an AI-supported fashion design and shopping platform connecting personal creativity with made-to-order production. Shoppers can create their own garments with guidance from Tara, its AI design assistant, or shop collections from Featured Creators. The platform brings design tools, visualization, manufacturing and fulfillment together in one place.

About Brunnur Ventures

Brunnur Ventures is an Iceland-based venture capital firm investing at the seed and early stages in companies that pair breakthrough innovation with scalable business models and exceptional founders. Since 2015, Brunnur has backed companies from their earliest days, including the first Icelandic venture-backed company to reach a USD 2billion valuation on Nasdaq. Brunnur's team consists of founders turned investors who work hands-on with management on strategy, scaling and fundraising, from first check to IPO.

About Trends&Culture

Trends&Culture is a London-based creative agency led by CEO Tammy Smulders, specialising in brand strategy, creative direction and digital experiences for fashion and luxury brands. Combining strategic insight with a deep understanding of luxury, culture and contemporary consumer behaviour, the agency has created distinctive brand identities, compelling creative worlds and engaging digital experiences. Its portfolio spans fashion, jewellery, beauty and hospitality, with brand and digital experience work for leading names including Bottega Veneta, Alaïa, Berluti, MM6 Maison Margiela, Dunhill, Jessica McCormack and Belmond.

data.title: Best’s Market Segment Report: AM Best Maintains Stable Outlook on US Life/Annuity Insurance Segment
data.description:
Best’s Market Segment Report: AM Best Maintains Stable Outlook on US Life/Annuity Insurance Segment

AM Best has maintained its market segment outlook for the U.S. life/annuity insurance segment at stable, supported in part by consistent profitability that is likely to benefit from a higher interest rate environment in addition to the industry’s strong levels of risk-adjusted capitalization.

In its Best’s Market Segment Report, “Market Segment Outlook: US Life/Annuity,” AM Best states that annuity market sales are expected to moderate compared with recent historical trends, while life sales are likely to see consistent but low growth rates. However, concerns remain with respect to the quality of capital and reinsurance in parts of the industry as the exposure to Level 3 assets, private credit and affiliated assets continues to increase.

Amid increases in the use of private credit and offshore reinsurance, the regulatory landscape has also evolved. The NAIC has implemented an actuarial guideline that requires insurers to conduct and document cash flow testing that evaluates ceded reinsurance as part of the overall asset adequacy analysis. Increased reporting of key risks, assets supporting reinsurance, reserving and mortality risk are required. The first round of these filings covered around 80 companies and 100 reinsurance treaties.

“So far, we do not view this or other potential regulations as materially burdensome or a negative cause for concern,” said Erik Miller, senior director, AM Best. “Instead, we believe the increases in disclosures and testing will be a positive for the industry.”

AM Best expects slower sales growth in the coming year for products such as multi-year guaranteed annuities and fixed index annuities following a period of exceptional growth, and even at a flat premium growth, it would still be significantly higher than long-term averages. While sales of registered index-linked annuities (RILA) originally cannibalized some sales of variable annuities (VA), AM Best is expecting moderate growth in VA products linked to stronger equity markets and continued growth coming off a lower base of RILA.

AM Best’s outlook for 2027 expects more moderate sales growth and a strong competitive environment, which would reduce profitability on new sales, but the industry will benefit from strong reinvestment rates of return boosted by rising rates. “This environment means companies with strong existing books of business and established distribution partners should benefit, but newer entrants could be more impacted by a lower growth environment as they try and gain scale,” Miller said.

To access the full copy of this report, please visit http://www3.ambest.com/bestweek/purchase.asp?record_code=370892.

AM Best senior analysts will present the credit rating agency’s 2027 outlooks and discuss industry trends at a virtual briefing scheduled for Thursday, Dec. 3, 2026, at 11 a.m. ET. For more information, click here.

To view all Best’s Market Segment Outlooks, please visit http://www.ambest.com/ratings/RatingOutlook.asp.

AM Best is a global credit rating agency, news publisher and data analytics provider specializing in the insurance industry. Headquartered in the United States, the company does business in over 100 countries with regional offices in London, Amsterdam, Dubai, Hong Kong, Singapore and Mexico City. data.title: National Australia Bank Modernizes ATM Network with Diebold Nixdorf Cash Recycling ATMs and Payments Platform
data.description:
National Australia Bank Modernizes ATM Network with Diebold Nixdorf Cash Recycling ATMs and Payments Platform

National Australia Bank Modernizes ATM Network with Diebold Nixdorf Cash Recycling ATMs and Payments Platform

PR Newswire

NORTH CANTON, Ohio, Nov. 19, 2026

Integrated hardware and software solutions will enhance customer experiences, optimize cash management and support new physical and digital journeys for consumers across Australia

NORTH CANTON, Ohio, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD) announced that National Australia Bank (NAB) is modernizing customer experiences across its self-service network with more than 700 DN Series® cash recycling ATMs combined with the company's next-generation Vynamic® Acquiring platform. 

Through 2028, NAB will upgrade its ATMs while transforming the software infrastructure that supports physical and digital transactions. Vynamic Acquiring is built on Diebold Nixdorf's Vynamic Transaction Middleware platform and uses cloud-native, microservices-based architecture. The solution will help NAB modernize its switching environment, support regulatory compliance and introduce new customer journeys. 

NAB's ATMs support more than 500,000 transactions each week, underscoring the continued importance of convenient, dependable cash access alongside digital and in-branch banking. The initiative will:

  • Improve availability across NAB's network with modern, highly reliable ATMs, with at least two at most branches.
  • Streamline the cash cycle by securely reusing deposited banknotes for future withdrawals, reducing replenishment needs.
  • Deliver a significantly improved customer experience through clearer screens, faster processing and additional accessibility and language options.
  • Reduce ATM disputes and improve resolution outcomes by increasing visibility into cash transactions, user interactions and deposits and withdrawals.

ATM monitoring, diagnostics, services and maintenance will be provided by ITS, Diebold Nixdorf's licensed partner in Australia.

Paul Carter, Executive Retail Banking at National Australia Bank at National Australia Bank, said: "Our investment in Diebold Nixdorf's cash recycling ATMs and payments middleware strengthens our commitment to providing convenient, dependable cash access and the best customer experience in this market for individuals and small businesses across Australia. By automating more cash-handling processes, improving cash availability and reducing operational interventions, we can serve customers more dependably and efficiently wherever and whenever they need access to their money."

Jaivinder Singh Gill, senior vice president and managing director, Banking and Retail - APMEA at Diebold Nixdorf, said: "NAB's modernization shows how self-service technology and software can strengthen critical banking infrastructure while creating more connected customer experiences. We are proud to partner with NAB on this nationwide transformation, combining intelligent cash recycling technology, advanced payments software and local expertise to make everyday banking more convenient, secure and reliable."

About 88% of the Group's workforce is located in Australia and New Zealand, while others work in Asia, London, New York and Paris. NAB is proud to be Australia's largest business lender. data.title: Arta Launches Arta Pay, Introducing Personal Credit Lines for Art, Luxury, and Collectibles
data.description:
Arta Launches Arta Pay, Introducing Personal Credit Lines for Art, Luxury, and Collectibles

Arta's latest product gives collectors access to personal credit lines from $1,000 to $100,000+, allowing them to make 10 monthly payments over time while galleries, auction houses, and other sellers receive payment in full without assuming repayment or fraud risk.

Building on more than a decade of experience serving the art, luxury, and collectibles market, Arta Pay enables sellers to offer flexible financing online, in-store, and through invoices, with no processing fees or added financial risk.

Arta, the commerce infrastructure platform for the art, luxury and collectibles market, announces the launch of Arta Pay, a new personal credit line that allows US collectors to pay over time on purchases ranging from fine art and watches to jewelry and design.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261119020792/en/

Designed around the needs of collectors, Arta Pay gives them more flexibility in how they pay, with a deposit followed by nine fixed monthly payments and a flat finance charge known up front. Sellers receive payment in full within days, at no cost.

“We’ve spent years building the post-purchase technology that powers commerce across art, luxury, and collectibles, and Arta Pay builds on everything we’ve learned along the way while helping us lower the friction around the actual transactions themselves,” said Adam Fields, founder and CEO of Arta. “We’re bringing more flexibility to how people buy and sell in this market, making it possible for collectors to pay over time while sellers receive payment in full without taking on the financing risk.”

Much of the art, luxury, and collectibles market falls between a few thousand dollars and the low six figures, a price range where collectors have historically had limited financing options. Consumer financing products tend to focus on lower borrowing limits, while private banking solutions are typically reserved for much larger transactions, leaving a gap for collectors buying in between.

Arta Pay is designed to help fill that gap, offering personal credit lines from $1,000 to $100,000+, allowing collectors to finance individual purchases from a range of sellers across the art, luxury, and collectibles market and establish a broader collection budget. The online application takes just a few minutes. Most applications are decided in real time, and the soft credit check does not affect an applicant's credit score.

For art, luxury, and collectibles sellers, Arta Pay can be offered directly at checkout, whether online or in-store, or offline through an invoice for an individual transaction, supporting both e-commerce purchases and the more personal, relationship-driven nature of many high-value sales. Once a transaction is completed, Arta settles the full order value within five business days, assuming both the fraud and repayment risk. The service also carries no processing fees for sellers.

Arta Pay is now live and available for sellers to offer their customers, with businesses including SwissWatchExpo and Rago Wright already using the service.

“Our collectors want flexibility in how they buy, and Arta Pay gives them that. It helps more bidders take home the works they love, with the option to pay over time,” said Richard Wright, CEO of Rago Wright. “For us, it means offering that flexibility without taking on credit risk or managing the financing ourselves. Arta already is a trusted technology partner of ours, so adding Arta Pay was a natural next step.”

Since their launch in 2021, Arta has worked with leading businesses across the art, luxury, and collectibles markets, including Sotheby's, Bonhams, Arena Club, Artsy, and Swiss Watch Expo, among many others. Today, the company operates in more than 65 countries and has facilitated over $1 billion in item value. With the introduction of Arta Pay, Arta is building on its established commerce technology platform, which automates fulfillment, insurance, cross border movements and item visibility, to address another key part of the buying and selling process: how transactions are financed.

For more information about Arta Pay, visit arta.io/artapay.

Financing is subject to eligibility and credit approval. Arta Pay is currently available to US citizens and residents. Arta is not a bank. Arta Pay line of credit is originated by Lead Bank. Terms apply.

Iron Horse Auction Co. Brings Two Sycamore Dairy Road Commercial Properties to Online Auction

Iron Horse Auction Co. Brings Two Sycamore Dairy Road Commercial Properties to Online Auction

PR Newswire

ROCKINGHAM, N.C., Nov. 19, 2026

Commercial showroom on ±1.08 acres and former batting cage facility on ±0.70 acres offered at online-only auction; bidding closes Dec. 9 beginning at 2 p.m.

ROCKINGHAM, N.C., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On November 19, 2026, Iron Horse Auction Co. announced they will sell, two commercial properties, located directly across the street from each other on Fayetteville's Sycamore Dairy Road, in an online-only auction. 

Bidding opens Dec. 2 at https://www.ironhorseauction.com/catalog/183336/ultimate-choice and closes Dec. 9 beginning at 2 p.m.

The offering includes an auto dealership showroom on ±1.08 acres at 3618 Sycamore Dairy Rd. and a former batting cage facility on ±0.70 acres at 3701 Sycamore Dairy Rd. Both properties are zoned Limited Commercial and will be offered individually in the same auction event. Both sites sit in central Fayetteville with easy access to Skibo Road, McPherson Church Road and Bragg Boulevard, with I-295 and I-95 minutes away.

Prospective buyers can tour both properties during an on-site preview Friday, Dec. 4, from 10 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., or by appointment.

"Commercial sites on a high-traffic retail corridor like Sycamore Dairy Road don't come up often, especially two right across the street from one another. The auction puts every buyer on equal footing: preview the properties, set your price and know the outcome Dec. 9," said Anthony Bristow, auctioneer with Iron Horse Auction Co.

Sycamore Dairy Road carries approximately 14,500 vehicles per day (NCDOT) and is lined with national retailers and minutes from Cross Creek Mall. Nearby Fort Bragg, one of the largest military installations in the country, drives steady traffic and demand throughout the area.

IQST - IQSTEL Issues Shareholder Letter Outlining 2027 Growth Roadmap Built on $313 Million in Nine-Month Revenue

IQST - IQSTEL Issues Shareholder Letter Outlining 2027 Growth Roadmap Built on $313 Million in Nine-Month Revenue

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026

CEO Leandro Iglesias outlines three drivers for 2027: the proposed Ultranet acquisition, the Q1 2027 commercial launch of IQSTEL Digital's microdrama service, and a step-up in profitability and cash generation across the platform.

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

Letter to Shareholders

November 19, 2026

Dear Shareholders,

I believe 2027 will be the most important year in IQSTEL's history. Much of what we built in 2026 was designed to set up what comes next: a larger and more profitable telecom platform, a new stream of recurring digital revenue, and a clear path toward consolidated positive cash flow.

Our accomplishments in 2026 have built strong momentum as we head into 2027. Through the first nine months of 2026, we generated $313.0 million in consolidated revenue, up 34.5% from the same period in 2025. We completed the first financing tranche intended to support our proposed acquisition of Ultranet. And on November 10, our first mobile operator partner approved the start of integration for IQSTEL Digital's microdrama service, which we are targeting for commercial launch in the first quarter of 2027.

Each of these milestones points to the same objective: use the scale and commercial reach of our telecom business to deliver stronger margins, cash generation and recurring revenue. Here is how we intend to do that in 2027.

Our 2027 growth plan at a glance

Growth driver

What we are working to deliver in 2027

Telecom platform

Grow from the scale we built in 2026, including two consecutive
quarters above $100 million in revenue and relationships with more
than 600 operators in 24 countries

Ultranet acquisition

Close the proposed 51% acquisition of a profitable West African
operator and begin integration, with a combined annualized revenue
run rate expected above $500 million

IQSTEL Digital

Launch commercially with our first operator in Q1 2027 and work
toward 300,000 active paid monthly microdrama subscriptions
across the program

Profitability

Move our Operating Adjusted EBITDA run rate toward approximately
$9 million and advance our goal of consolidated positive cash flow

These are management objectives and expectations, not guidance or completed results. Each depends on execution, closing conditions and market demand, as described below.

Telecom: the platform we are building on

Our telecom business is the engine behind every part of our 2027 plan. It provides the operator relationships, technical connections and operating base that make our next stage of growth possible. The nine-month results show the scale we carry into the new year:

Nine months ended September 30, 2026

Result

Consolidated revenue

$313.0 million, up 34.5% year over year

$7.81 million, up 19.3%

$277.6 million

Stockholders' equity at September 30

$17.67 million

Third-quarter consolidated revenue was $106.0 million, our second consecutive quarter above $100 million. We are working toward our $430 million revenue objective for 2026, which will require a strong fourth quarter, and we intend to build on that base in 2027.

Just as important as the revenue is what we can now distribute through this platform. The interconnections, integrations and billing relationships we have developed with more than 600 telecommunications operators in 24 countries give us established channels to introduce higher-margin services without building distribution from scratch. In 2027, our focus is to put those channels to work.

Ultranet: a step-change in scale and cash generation

Our proposed acquisition of a 51% controlling interest in Ultranet Telecom Group is designed to add both scale and profitability to our platform in 2027. Ultranet is a profitable telecom operator in West Africa. On a 100% basis, its audited 2025 results were:

Ultranet audited 2025 results

100% basis

Revenue

$130.9 million

EBITDA

$5.0 million

Net income

$4.6 million

Operating cash flow

$5.5 million

These are Ultranet's historical results, not results currently attributable to IQSTEL. We have signed a binding memorandum of understanding and completed the first financing tranche intended to support the acquisition. The senior secured notes are not convertible at the lenders' election; the financing also includes pre-funded warrants for $420,000, as disclosed in our Form 10-Q. We are working toward a definitive acquisition agreement and are targeting closing in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the required terms and conditions.

Ultranet is central to our profitability roadmap. The table below shows how we expect our Operating Adjusted EBITDA run rate to build as each stage of our plan is delivered:

Operating Adjusted EBITDA run rate

Management estimate or objective

Following organic growth

Approximately $9 million

Longer-term Digital Services development

If completed, we expect the acquisition could lift our combined annualized revenue run rate above $500 million and make a meaningful contribution to our goal of consolidated positive cash flow. These are management expectations, not completed results or guidance. Operating Adjusted EBITDA excludes holding-company costs and is not consolidated Adjusted EBITDA.

IQSTEL Digital: 2027 is our launch year

IQSTEL Digital is how we intend to turn the reach of our operator network into recurring, higher-margin revenue. The networks of our telecom customers collectively serve approximately 2.3 billion end users. Those users are not IQSTEL subscribers, but their scale shows the opportunity in front of us. Our first digital product is a mobile microdrama service developed through our partnership with IDILIO TV, and we have moved quickly from announcement to integration:

2027 objective

300,000 active paid monthly subscriptions across the program

The first operator's network serves approximately 14 million subscribers. Under our planning assumptions, it could support up to 105,000 active paid monthly microdrama subscriptions. Reaching our 2027 objective of 300,000 active paid monthly subscriptions will depend on adding operators from our initial outreach group and beyond, as well as on integration, operator execution and customer demand.

At 300,000 subscriptions, our illustrative model indicates $1.8 million to $3.6 million in annualized profit contribution. Our plan is to launch, measure results with our first operator, and use what we learn as the template for expanding across our operator relationships. Over the longer term, we see Digital Services as the primary driver of our path toward a $15 million Operating Adjusted EBITDA run rate.

Our priorities for 2027

Our team is focused on five priorities:

Finish 2026 strongly. Close the year with a strong fourth quarter as we work toward our $430 million revenue objective.

Close and integrate Ultranet. Complete the definitive agreement and closing on acceptable terms, then integrate Ultranet's profitable operations into our platform.

Launch and scale IQSTEL Digital. Go live with our first operator in Q1 2027, add operators through the year, and work toward 300,000 active paid monthly subscriptions.

Turn scale into margins and cash flow. Raise our Operating Adjusted EBITDA run rate and advance our goal of consolidated positive cash flow.

Keep shareholders informed. Report our progress against these objectives clearly and consistently, and expand our engagement with the investment community throughout the year.

As part of that engagement, I invite you to review Edison Investment Research's latest note on IQSTEL, "Another steady step forward in Q326," published on November 18, 2026 following our third-quarter results. Edison highlights our sustained organic growth, the continued operating profitability of our Telecom business and our balance sheet, and notes that the IQSTEL Digital launch remains on track for the first quarter of 2027. After adjusting its 2026 estimates for the Ultranet closing now expected in the first quarter of 2027, Edison left its 2027 and 2028 forecasts and its $6 per share valuation assessment unchanged. The full note and Edison's September 2026 initiation report are available on our Investor Relations website at https://ir.iqstel.com/analyst-coverage. IQSTEL is a research client of Edison and paid for the research; Edison's forecasts and valuation are its own and should not be read as Company guidance.

We have built a business with substantial scale. 2027 is about converting that scale into higher margins, recurring digital revenue, cash generation and lasting value for our shareholders. I am confident in our direction and in the team executing this plan.

Thank you for your continued confidence in IQSTEL and in the people working to deliver this next phase of our growth.

Sincerely,

Leandro Iglesias
President and Chief Executive Officer
IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST)

About IQSTEL Inc.

IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) is a global telecommunications and technology company operating through two core business divisions: Telecom and Digital Services. The Telecom Division is the foundation of IQSTEL's global platform, operating across 20 countries with more than 600 telecommunications carrier interconnections and delivering international voice, SMS, messaging, and connectivity solutions to some of the world's largest telecom operators and enterprise customers. Through these customer relationships, IQSTEL's platform has the potential to reach approximately 2.3 billion end users worldwide. Building on this global infrastructure and commercial reach, the Digital Services Division is focused on higher-margin technology solutions across Content Services, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Communications, Cybersecurity, Fintech, and Enterprise Automation. Built through nearly two decades of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, IQSTEL is leveraging the scale and reach of its Telecom business to accelerate the growth of Digital Services and drive its next phase of revenue and adjusted EBITDA expansion.

data.title: Actinogen pivotal Alzheimer’s disease trial demonstrates clinical benefit in older patients with mild to moderate disease, favorable safety profile and trends towards benefit in the overall population
data.description:
SYDNEY, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Actinogen Medical Limited (ASX: ACW) today announces topline results from its pivotal, placebo-controlled XanaMIA phase 2b/3 trial of oral emestedastat (Xanamem®) over 36 weeks of treatment in 247 patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and elevated levels of the pTau181 blood biomarker.

In a prespecified analysis of participants above the median age of 75 years, a statistically and clinically significant benefit on the Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB) zero progression rate (40% vs. 22%, p=0.02) for Xanamem was observed, together with a clinically significant rate of 30% disease slowing (mean CDR-SB superiority of 0.39 points at Week 36, p=0.22). These findings may be related to the known increase in the target 11β-HSD1 enzyme expression with age. For context, this rate of disease slowing is similar to that claimed by Eli Lilly and Eisai for their approved therapies donanemab and lecanemab.

In the overall population, Xanamem was numerically, but not statistically superior to placebo for the primary endpoint of delayed disease progression, measured by the CDR-SB at Weeks 12, 24 and 36, with a mean Xanamem benefit compared with placebo of 0.10 CDR-SB points at Week 36 (p = 0.65). Small and non-significant trends favoring Xanamem on the key secondary endpoints of cognition and “Activities of Daily Living” were also observed.

The previously established, favorable safety profile for Xanamem 10 mg administered daily for up to 12 weeks was replicated over the longer treatment period of 36 weeks with no serious adverse events attributed to the drug.

Actinogen’s CEO, Dr Steven Gourlay, commented:

“Following our initial analysis of the XanaMIA trial we remain confident in the risk-benefit profile of Xanamem in mild to moderate Alzheimer’s disease. There were notable findings of significant disease slowing and disease stabilization rates in older participants, who represent a poorly served and large segment of the market. After further analysis we plan to explore the trial data with potential partners and the US FDA over the coming months to determine the optimal development path for Xanamem in an older patient population.”

Given its established safety profile in more than 500 participants, oral route of administration and lack of drug-drug interaction potential, Xanamem is particularly well suited as a treatment for the older, more complex AD population, most of whom are on multiple medications including older AD treatments like acetylcholinesterase inhibitors.

Further results will be presented at a future scientific meeting.

A video recording of a webinar conducted by senior management of the company to discuss the topline results is available at: https://tinyurl.com/mr3js44b

_________
® Xanamem is a registered trademark of Actinogen Medical Limited

About Actinogen Medical

Actinogen Medical (ACW) is an ASX-listed, biotechnology company in the late clinical stages of development for Xanamem® (emestedastat), its novel oral therapy for Alzheimer’s disease. Xanamem also has other applications in diseases driven by elevated tissue cortisol including depression. The Company is based in Sydney, Australia with operations and clinical trials in Australia and the US. Xanamem has been studied in eight clinical trials with more than 500 people treated to date and has a promising safety and efficacy profile with treatment up to 36 weeks.

About the phase 2b/3 XanaMIA pivotal trial and Open Label Extension (OLE) phase

The XanaMIA trial was a randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b/3 trial evaluating Xanamem 10 mg versus placebo over 36 weeks in 247 participants across Australia and the United States. The primary endpoint was the placebo-subtracted difference in the CDR-SB at the end of 36 weeks of treatment. Key secondary endpoints were a cognition composite and a measure of “activities of daily living”. On 19 November 2026 Actinogen reported the initial results from the trial, showing clinically significant slowing in participants over the age of 75 but not in the whole trial population. Further analyses are on-going. The OLE phase of the trial is on-going following closure of enrolment of 168 participants in November 2026.

About Xanamem (emestedastat)

Xanamem’s novel mechanism of action is to control the level of cortisol in brain, liver and adipose tissue (fat) through the inhibition of the tissue cortisol synthesis enzyme, 11β-HSD1, without blocking normal production of cortisol by the adrenal glands. Xanamem is a first-in-class, once-a-day pill designed to deliver high levels of tissue cortisol control in regions where 11β-HSD1 is highly expressed such as the hippocampus and grey matter in the brain, as well as in liver and adipose tissue. Chronically elevated cortisol is associated with progression in Alzheimer’s Disease and excess cortisol is known to be toxic to brain cells. Elevated cortisol is also associated with more severe forms of depression. Xanamem has demonstrated excellent target enzyme engagement and in human trials has shown potential benefit in older people with Alzheimer’s disease and anti-depressive benefits in patients with moderately severe depression. To view Xanamem’s two-minute Mechanism of Action animation, click here.

Xanamem is an investigational product and is not approved for use outside of a clinical trial by the FDA or by any global regulatory authority. Xanamem® is a trademark of Actinogen Medical.

data.title: If the AI trade unwinds, other pillars holding up the U.S. economy are 'irrelevant,' says Barclays
data.description:
By Nora Redmond

Barclays said it's targeting 8,700 for the S&P 500 in 2027.

If the artificial-intelligence trade really is unwinding, the other pillars holding up the U.S. economy are "irrelevant," according to strategists at Barclays.

For much of the past year, both the U.S. - and to a considerable degree, the global economy - have been supported by three pillars: the strength of the U.S. consumer, the durability of companies' financial results and the resilience of AI capital expenditure, the British bank highlighted in its outlook for the year ahead.

The first two have stayed standing, said Ajay Rajadhyaksha, global chairman of research. U.S. consumption has contributed 1.8% to gross domestic product growth this year, with the economy growing 2.7% in the first three quarters and expected to expand 3.2% in the final quarter, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta's GDPNow tool.

For corporate earnings, about 84% of S&P 500 names have beaten analysts' estimates so far in the third quarter, bringing blended growth to 31% year-on-year. Wall Street consensus is for earnings growth of 15% in 2027, which if realized, will make the 2025 to 2027 period the strongest three-year period for earnings in a number of decades, he said.

"But all of that is irrelevant if the AI trade is truly unraveling," the strategist warned, noting that the tool has added more than one point to U.S. economic growth this year -and even that figure underestimates its influence as AI has affected virtually every sector.

Rajadhyaksha wrote: "The vast majority of trillion-dollar companies globally are AI-sensitive names. If the AI trade collapses, equity valuations will follow. Wealth effects will turn negative. The mighty U.S. consumer could finally wobble. The dominoes falling would extend far beyond technology."

Barclays forecasts the S&P 500 SPX to reach 8,700 in 2027, a target in line with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley's.

That said, Barclays doesn't see the beginning stages of a collapse in the AI trade, instead arguing there's a correction, with investors rotating into cyclical, healthcare and defence stocks.

Despite a prolonged war in Iran, significant spikes in oil prices (CL00), turmoil in the French bond market BX:TMBMKFR-10Y and the sharpest selloff in AI stocks since the cycle first kicked off, global growth has managed to prevail, Rajadhyaksha and a team of strategists wrote in a separate note. The bank is targeting a 3.4% year-on-year global growth rate and a 2.4% expansion for the U.S.

For Rajadhyaksha, the overbuilding of AI will eventually become a problem - but not in 2027.

"A years-long bull market is unlikely to die when the leading semiconductor names have already de-rated sharply and trade at three to four times forward earnings - priced like distressed cyclicals," he said. "That is what mid-cycle fear looks like, not a bubble about to pop."

The PHLX semiconductor index SOX has dropped 34% from its June peak.

And on the Democrats' sweep of the midterm elections, the strategist wrote that some delays to the construction of data centers may actually benefit technology companies by minimizing the risk of overbuilding.

For the year ahead, Barclays is overweight equities over bonds and advises selectively buying into the AI correction.

Rajadhyaksha and the team of strategists recommend increasing exposure to established hyperscalers, profitable semiconductor names and companies that have proved monetization from AI and have the balance sheets to fund its development internally.

"We would be more cautious on businesses whose valuations depend on uninterrupted access to external capital, distant free cash flow or data center projects that have yet to secure power and permits," the strategists said.

They recommend value, quality and healthcare names as preferred hedges in the U.S. and European equities for those still skeptical about AI. But the bank also said all investors should broaden their exposure beyond just tech, maintaining a core allocation to the sector, while also buying more healthcare XLV, industrial XLIand high-quality growth stocks.

-Nora Redmond
